name: Steam Train
summary: Old steam locomotive with chimney, boiler, cab and coal tender; puffs smoke circles from the chimney when driving.

params.name: y
params.note: rail line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 900 px wide and 470 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels turn, body bounces and smoke circles puff from the chimney

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the engine faces left

author: krakujs
